competitors.title: AI Agent Frameworks Comparison 2026: LangChain vs CrewAI vs AutoGen vs LangGraph
key_points: LangChain: most mature ecosystem, LangGraph for stateful agent workflows, LCEL for composable chains
CrewAI: role-based multi-agent orchestration, simplest API for multi-agent teams
AutoGen (AG2): Microsoft Research, conversational multi-agent, code execution sandbox
LangGraph: graph-based state machine for complex agent workflows with conditional branching

competitors.title: OpenAI Agents SDK vs LangGraph vs CrewAI: Choosing Your Framework
key_points: OpenAI Agents SDK: lightweight, handoffs + guardrails, Python-native, 9K+ GitHub stars
LangGraph: most powerful for complex workflows with state persistence, checkpointing, branching
CrewAI: best for role-based multi-agent scenarios with minimal code
Decision framework: simple agent → OpenAI SDK; complex workflow → LangGraph; role-based → CrewAI

competitors.title: LangGraph vs CrewAI vs AutoGen: Agent Framework Comparison (LangChain Blog)
